problems.title: Cache-dependent normalized-relative score mixes feature coordinates
problems.claim: Relative Mahalanobis++ applies feature normalization to both class and global fits before evaluating the relative score.
problems.location: Paper p7 and Appendix G p34; NINCO/detection_methods.py:548–662; evaluate.py:28–37,109,217,244,274–287,416; README:100.
assumptions: Normalized class caches exist; normalized global caches do not; caller supplies raw training features.
Every covariance in the witness is positive definite; score is the paper's finite-feature estimator.
problems.check: 500 classes use {(2,0),(0,2),(-2,0)}, 500 use {(2,0),(0,-2),(-2,0)}. C=diag(2/3,2/9), G=diag(2/3,1/3), raw G=4G. For e2 and (4/5,3/5), correct scores are (1,19/25), mixed scores (-5/4,-77/100). Exact SymPy and independent NumPy fits agree.
problems.result: The mixed fit reverses sample ordering and is not the stated normalized-relative estimator.
problems.counterevidence: Relative-first empty-cache execution and correct existing global caches avoid the defect; primary Maha++ and OpenOOD CIFAR relative code are unaffected by this branch. Historical table impact is unknown.
problems.impact: Substantive defect in a promoted normalized variant and its released evaluation dependency; whole-paper failure or measured benchmark loss is not asserted.
problems.correction: Normalize training features before either fit and rebuild affected global/statistic-dependent score caches with explicit provenance.

problems.title: Gaussian variance expansion omits the rotated mean
problems.claim: Lemma 3.1 defines the squared-norm variance using covariance eigenvalues and unqualified original mean coordinates.
assumptions: X is Gaussian; Sigma positive definite.
Original mean coordinates are not silently redefined after rotation.
problems.check: For Sigma=[[2,1],[1,2]], mu=(1,0), actual variance is 28; unrotated pairings give 24 or32. Correct invariant expression is 2 tr(Sigma²)+4 muᵀSigma mu.
problems.result: The displayed expansion requires eigenbasis mean coordinates.
problems.counterevidence: Appendix B explicitly states rotated mean Uᵀmu, restoring the valid argument when subsequent mu_i means those coordinates.
problems.impact: Local mathematical statement/notation defect; no empirical dependency or probability-threshold violation claimed.
problems.correction: Use the invariant expression or explicitly replace mu_i by (Uᵀmu)_i.

problems.title: Universal comparator wording and model-win count exceed displayed results
problems.claim: All considered cosine/KNN cases improve; Table4 has30/44 Maha++ wins; relative normalization improves across models/datasets.
problems.check: Table4 gives29 Maha++,6 relative++,5 ViM,3 rawMaha,1Ash winners. NINCO EffNet cosine58.8 beats Maha++59.9; CIFAR100 RN34 KNN74.44 beats74.51; Table2 relative iNat regressions2.0→2.2 and3.5→3.9.
problems.result: The universal wording and win count require local correction.
problems.counterevidence: Appendix explicitly discloses exceptions; 41/44 counterpart improvements and average advantage remain supported.
problems.impact: Local summary errors, not a refutation of aggregate normalization benefit.
problems.correction: Qualify comparator statements and reconcile the count with the displayed table.
